{{Top|Reb}}
A '''quantum crystal''' was a frozen form of crystal which emits strong energy in the form of X-radiation. Often these are small crystals with specific applications.

The smaller of the two stars that formed the [[Crseih system/Legends|Crseih system]] was condensed into a immense quantum crystal. Its energy emissions were so strong that they eventually warped the very fabric of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. This, when combined with the suffering induced by [[Hethrir]] in the prisons on [[Crseih Station]], caused the being [[Waru]] to be pulled into the galaxy.<ref name="Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>
